title: narcissus poeticus subsp. verbanensis
intro: Narcissus poeticus subsp. verbanensis, commonly known as the Poeticus Narcissus, is a species of daffodil that originates from Italy. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its ability to lower cholesterol levels, prevent cancer, and exhibit anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Narcissus poeticus subsp. verbanensis are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which have been shown to exhibit sedative, anti-spasmodic, and anti-bacterial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant are also known to exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities, contributing to its potential therapeutic applications.
